"""Live RoboLab limited-mode episode controller (rcb-limited/2.0).
This file is the interactive control record for the single animals_in_bin episode.
"""
import sys, os, json, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print('Connected:', r.base, '| protocol:', spec['protocol'], '| task:', spec['task_text'], flush=True)
q_down = np.array([0.0, -0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0], dtype=float)
out = '/app/output/episode'
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)

def observe(label='obs', seconds=0.0, video='none'):
    global o
    o = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
    print('OBS', label, json.dumps(o.meta, separators=(',',':')), flush=True)
    for cam, im in o.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(out, f'{label}_{cam}.png'))
    return o

def pose(x, y, z, grip=0, q=q_down, note=''):
    global last
    a = np.array([[x,y,z,*q,grip]], dtype=np.float32)
    last = r.submit('ee_pose', a, video='frames', note=note)
    print('POSE', [round(float(v),4) for v in a[0]], json.dumps(last.meta, separators=(',',':')), flush=True)
    for cam, im in last.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(out, f'step{last.meta.get("step","x")}_{cam}.png'))
    return last

def jp(q, grip=0, dt=0.2, note=''):
    global last
    a = np.r_[np.asarray(q,dtype=np.float32), np.float32(grip)]
    last = r.submit('joint_position', a[None,:], dt=dt, video='frames', note=note)
    print('JOINT', json.dumps(last.meta, separators=(',',':')), flush=True)
    for cam, im in last.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(out, f'step{last.meta.get("step","x")}_{cam}.png'))
    return last

print('Proprio:', json.dumps(r.get_obs(video='none').meta['proprio']), flush=True)
print('Helpers ready: pose(x,y,z,grip=0,note=""), observe(label), jp(joints,grip=0), r, spec', flush=True)
